description:
merges multiple selected aims into one. 
combines all connections. 
Useful e.g. when having duplicate aims or when reducing complexity (one more encompassing aim instead of too detailed ones).
reflection: Completed and hardened the existing multi-select merge workflow. Existing list/graph selection and range-selection UX already covered selecting multiple aims and choosing a target. Updated mergeSelectedInto so successful backend rewires trigger a complete local aim-graph refresh, merged/failed counts reflect actual outcomes, and partial failures no longer report success. Added focused success and partial-failure tests. Verification: frontend 212/212 tests and production build pass.

status.comment: Multi-select merge workflow is implemented, refreshed after rewiring, and accurately reports partial failures. Awaiting explicit user acceptance before done.
